    AI Overview

    AI Mode reply for digikhata pakistani company

    DigiKhata is a Pakistan-based financial technology (fintech) company founded in 2020 by Adnan Aslam and Bilal Anjum. It operates a free mobile and web-based bookkeeping, accounting, and business management platform designed for micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs). 
    Core Offerings & Features
    • Digital Ledgers & Bookkeeping: Tracks customer/supplier ledgers (Party Ledger), daily cash flows (Cash Book), staff attendance/payroll (Staff Book), and inventory levels (Stock Book). 
    • Billing & Reminders: Provides custom invoice generation (Bill Book) and automated/free SMS and WhatsApp payment reminders. 
    • Payments & Financial Services:
      • DigiPOS: Allows phones to accept contactless NFC debit and credit card payments.
      • DigiQR: Instant zero-fee QR payments with voice alerts.
      • Nano Lending: Digital loans up to PKR 50,000 via a streamlined application process. 
    • E-Commerce: Offers Digi Dokaan, a platform to create a basic online store in seconds. 
    • Multilingual Support: Available in English, Roman Urdu, Urdu, Sindhi, Pashto, and Persian. 
    Company Background & Milestones
    • Funding: Raised $2 million in seed funding led by investors such as MSA Capital and SOSV. 
    • Accelerators & Partnerships: Alumni of the Telenor Velocity program (partnering with Telenor and Easypaisa) and collaborated with Jazz Business. 
    • Regulatory Recognition: Participated in the State Bank of Pakistan's first Regulatory Sandbox cohort and became an approved ICAP training organization for chartered accountants. 
    If you'd like, I can provide details on:
    • How to download or set up the DigiKhata app
    • Comparison with competitors like Khatabook
    • How to use DigiPOS or DigiQR
